stem:
Dev runs on a square track whose perimeter is $200$ m. He runs $650$ m from a start mark that is also the finish line.

Which two claims are correct?

options.text: Call "one round" the leftover distance alone.
The leftover distance is $50$ m along the track from the finish line.
Report $650$ alone, because that numeral is printed largest.

teacher.key_rationale: 650 = 3*200 + 50, so 3 full rounds and 50 m leftover from the common finish. A renames leftover as a round. D grabs the printed distance.
